title: Design system — Care
description: Calm lagoon blue, warm peach, 17px text and 44px targets, accessible by default.
forWho: Healthcare, clinics, therapy, wellness and care services

tiles.title: Design system — Care
tiles.hero:
Here to help

Easy to read,
easy to reach.

Lagoon blue and warm peach, large text and big, calm targets.

AppointmentsResultsMessages
tiles.text:
## Principles

- Readable by everyone: 17px text, high contrast, plain words.
- Calm, then clear: alarms are rare, so they are noticed.
- Easy to hit: everything a person presses is at least 44 pixels tall.

## Starter profile

- **Fits:** clinics, hospitals, therapy, pharmacy, elder care, wellness, public services. Not for nightlife, gaming.
- **Mood:** caring, calm; density airy; shape round; contrast high; light first.
- **Type:** Atkinson Hyperlegible, ui-monospace.
- **Adapt first:** primary, link, accent. **Keep:** text-body, text-label, control-height, foreground.

## Using tokens

Use a token by its name, never its value. Change a value here and every screen and every component sample below follows: colors, type, spacing, corners, shadows, opacity and motion. Each color shows its light and dark values and is checked against the color it is read on.

## Using components

Build screens from the components in this system. Each one is drawn below in its states, with a note on when to use it. When one is missing, add a row to Components.

## Accessibility

Text reaches 4.5:1 against what it sits on; control edges and focus 3:1. Focus is always visible. Nothing is told by color alone.
